A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have constructed a dual-tag system that is able to express fusion proteins with the maltose-binding and His-tags and the Smt3 protein, which allows the purification of the protein of interest by affinity chromatography and the processing of fusion proteins by a protease.
we have developed a system for the production, purification and processing of fusion proteins in E. coli which can be used for the expression of a wide range of different protein sequences.
we constructed a system for the expression of a fusion protein consisting of a maltose-binding protein, a His-tag and Smt3.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Smt3 system can be applied to E. coli and that it is a promising system for protein processing in this host.
a dual-tag system consisting of the MalE and His tags and the Smt3 protein is an efficient tool for the expression, purification and processing of fusion proteins in E. coli.
we were able to establish a system for the efficient expression and purification of fusion proteins and their processing in a single host organism.
